purpose: Register a staged Source PPO curriculum for six predeclared skill families. This file records candidate stage logic only; it does not authorize PPO training, a qualification scan, or checkpoint publication.

research_principles.family_selection_basis: predeclared movement mechanisms and transfer value, not frozen flat-PPO success alone
research_principles.baseline_success_rate_role: calibrate curriculum entry, promotion, rollback, and diagnostic priority; not a family admission gate
research_principles.skill_learning_objective: learn new contact, posture, foot-placement, height-transition, or slip-compensation behavior through staged Source training
research_principles.failure_interpretation: preserve a family when the failure is informative or decomposable; lower the level, add an intermediate level, or repair diagnostics before removing a family
research_principles.training_authorization: none; all numeric shares, promotion cutoffs, rollback cutoffs, and transition budgets remain proposals until a later lock action

family_skill_targets.skill_target: retain the base gait, speed tracking, and stable support while other skills are introduced
recover from asynchronous support heights and multi-scale continuous contact changes
control posture and support while the gravity direction changes on uphill, downhill, and cross-slope tracks
lift and place feet across repeated risers while maintaining body height, support, and forward progress
family_skill_targets.direction_requirement: ascending and descending must be registered separately

family_skill_targets.skill_target: combine gravity-direction control with bounded asynchronous contact variation
family_skill_targets.combination_gate: a combined level cannot be promoted while its corresponding single-family factors lack a consistent diagnostic boundary

family_skill_targets.skill_target: compensate for spatially varying support friction and reduce foot slip without relying on uniform low friction

curriculum_stages.purpose: Give each predeclared family a learnable starting point and preserve the base gait.
curriculum_stages.sampling_policy: Use the registered six-family Pilot shares as the outer family proposal; stage-specific level shares and transition budgets must be locked separately.
promotion_requires: diagnostic evidence is internally consistent for the family
the family produces nontrivial forward or posture-control feedback rather than immediate universal termination
no unresolved safety or contact-mapping blocker for the promoted level
the registered multi-metric report is complete
curriculum_stages.rollback_action: keep the family at L1, reduce its level share, or insert an intermediate geometry; do not delete the family solely because the frozen flat PPO fails

curriculum_stages.purpose: Increase repeated contact, posture, and recovery demands while retaining an easier recovery distribution.
curriculum_stages.sampling_policy: Retain L1 as a recovery and anti-forgetting component while introducing L2 only for families whose promotion gate is satisfied.
promotion_requires: multi-seed evidence of recoverable progress at the candidate L2
no unresolved mismatch between termination terms and contact-force evidence
motion quality and safety metrics remain within the later locked Source bounds
source-only validation seeds remain disjoint from curriculum-development seeds
curriculum_stages.rollback_action: reduce L2 exposure and restore L1 exposure after repeated safety termination, near-zero progress, or unresolved evidence inconsistency

curriculum_stages.purpose: Expose stronger levels and registered geometry/layout variation after the underlying skill is stable.
curriculum_stages.sampling_policy: Introduce L3 and layout/seed variation only after the corresponding family has passed its L2 promotion gate; keep lower levels present for retention.
promotion_requires: L2 is stable on held-out Source validation seeds
the L3 geometry and contact audit are complete
the level remains inside the locked Source boundary and does not consume Development or Sealed seeds
curriculum_stages.rollback_action: return to the highest validated lower level and retain the failure evidence for a later curriculum review

promotion_and_rollback_policy.promotion_decision: must be made per family and level; an aggregate success rate cannot promote all families
rollback_triggers_candidate: near-zero progress at the level entry
repeated nonfoot contact or fall with no recoverable trajectory
unresolved discrepancy between termination terms and sensor evidence
source retention degradation beyond the later locked bound
promotion_and_rollback_policy.rollback_is_not: a decision to remove the skill family from Source

current_diagnostic_evidence.interpretation: single bounded diagnostic completed; not a qualification result
3/3 registered treads crossed but full-track completion was not reached; candidate skill-acquisition evidence
3/3 registered treads crossed and bounded completion reached; single-seed directional evidence only
fall near the first step; promotion is blocked pending contact/termination consistency and multi-seed evidence

repeat of the bounded diagnostic with configured-versus-triggered termination fields; bad_orientation_2 triggered, illegal_contact remained false, and contact mapping/threshold/three-step confirmation were internally consistent; promotion remains blocked pending first-riser audit and multi-seed evidence

multi_step_stairs_L2_ascending: contact/termination consistency verified in the retry3 diagnostic: configured non-foot mapping, 5 N threshold, three-control-step confirmation, and triggered-term state agree with the sensor history
verify the first-riser geometry and entry transition independently
repeat on registered diagnostic seeds before changing the candidate level
do not increase L2 sampling share until the first-riser audit and multi-seed evidence are complete
slope_plus_rough: qualify the corresponding single slope and rough factors before promoting the combined level
friction_variation: keep candidate material coefficients distinct from measured effective contact friction

data_isolation.curriculum_diagnostic_seeds: must remain disjoint from source_train, source_validation, development, probe, and sealed partitions
data_isolation.checkpoint: read-only model_1998.pt until a later Source PPO training lock

open_items_before_lock: set stage-specific family and level sampling shares
set promotion and rollback thresholds with uncertainty and sample-count rules
complete the L2 stairs first-riser geometry and entry-transition audit
complete multi-seed diagnostics for each family and direction
register the Source PPO transition budget and stopping rules
bind exact code, environment, checkpoint, and artifact hashes
non_authorization_statement: This draft records a curriculum proposal only. It must not be passed to a training runner or qualification runner until a later lock action supplies thresholds, budgets, hashes, approvals, and runtime qualifications.
